message.content:
A reflection across a line through the origin in \(\mathbb{R}^2\) has eigenvalues \(1\) and \(-1\):

- Vectors along the line of reflection are unchanged, so eigenvalue \(1\).
- Vectors perpendicular to the line are reversed, so eigenvalue \(-1\).

Thus,
\[
\det \mathbf{R}=1\cdot(-1)=-1.
\]

The answer is \(-1\).
